seo.title: Custom automation
seo.seo_description: Nexora builds agents and workflows with you, connected to your software, and tests them on your real cases before they go into service. Start with a diagnosis.

translation.headline: Your processes, automated your way.
translation.subheadline: When a standard solution is not enough, we build with you the agents and workflows that connect your software and your documents, and we test them on your real cases before go-live.

blocks.role: Trois exemples non interchangeables de processus sur mesure.

translation.title: Three processes, three builds.
translation.body: Custom work begins where standard solutions stop. Three constructed examples that do not look alike; they are not customer results.

items.title: A contractor finds past quotes.
items.text: They want to start from comparable earlier quotes to prepare a new one, and track real costs afterward. We would connect the quote base, an estimating agent and an approval before anything is sent. For construction, OPSYS-AI already covers part of this path, with its statuses.

items.title: A distributor processes supplier documents.
items.text: Delivery slips, order confirmations and invoices arrive in different formats. The workflow reads them, compares them with each other and flags what does not match, before any action.

items.title: A firm prepares case files.
items.text: It gathers authorized documents, draws a summary and a list of points to verify, then hands over to the responsible person. Access rights are defined before the build.

blocks.role: Notre façon de travailler : six temps, avec les outils de WorkStudio.

cards.title: 1. Observe.
cards.text: We look at how the work is done: where time is lost, what information comes in, who decides.

cards.title: 2. Prototype.
cards.text: We describe the workflow in plain language; WorkStudio's Copilot proposes a first version that we review and correct.

cards.title: 3. Connect.
cards.text: We connect your software through connectors, after checking that each one can be.

cards.title: 4. Test.
cards.text: We build a test set from your real cases and measure whether the agent answers well, before changing anything.

cards.title: 5. Approve.
cards.text: Every step that commits the business waits for a person. We decide with you which ones.

cards.title: 6. Train and operate.
cards.text: Your team learns to supervise and correct; we track what works and adjust the rest.

translation.title: What we build with.
translation.body: Everything is built in Nexora WorkStudio, which keeps the system readable and portable. Its components are delivered; it is their assembly for your case that is custom.

items.title: Agents.
items.text: Assistants that follow your instructions, use your tools and documents, and cite their sources.

items.title: Workflows.
items.text: Sequences of steps triggered by an email, a schedule, a request, with human approvals.

items.title: Documents and data.
items.text: Knowledge bases, reading of scanned documents, tables, batch processing.

items.title: Connectors and an API.
items.text: Services linked by Nexora Connect, and agents callable by API in the OpenAI format.

blocks.role: Limites : ce qui n'est pas un produit livré, ce qui se qualifie.

cards.title: An integration promised in advance.
cards.text: Software is connected only after qualification. Some connections require prior registration with the provider.

cards.title: Products not delivered.
cards.text: Telephony, camera vision and specialized models are not delivered products; we can study their feasibility, nothing more at this stage.

cards.title: A model that is too small.
cards.text: A small local model is not always enough for agents that call tools. The model is chosen with the case.

cards.title: An announced timeline or gain.
cards.text: No universal timeline and no quantified gain: everything is measured on a first case.

items.question: How is it different from a standard solution?
items.answer: A standard solution addresses a common problem and is configured. Custom work handles a process unique to your business, with its rules and its software.

items.question: Does the result belong to me?
items.answer: Your documents, configurations and workflows stay exportable, and the contract provides for it.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet. After the diagnosis, we provide a written estimate that states what is included and what is not.

items.question: Who maintains the system after go-live?
items.answer: We run it with you and keep it evolving. The exact split is written in the contract.

translation.title: Describe your process to us.
translation.text: Tell us what costs you time and with which software. We will tell you whether it is feasible, how, and which case to start with.
